description: A constant is its value in simplification, so where the final value of $E is empty, `$E ∩ tags($x)` uses no capture. The tag term then serves the alternative without $x, as it does with ∅ written, and the loader checks it once $E has that value (engine §3.6, §9).
grammar:
%const $E B
%rule text A | $x(A)
%tags Y ∪ ($E ∩ tags($x))
%redefine-const $E $E ∖ B
